q: For a 2D Hamiltonian system with H(x,y) as a conserved quantity, the phase portrait near an elliptic fixed point (center) consists of:
opts: Spiraling orbits converging to the fixed point
Closed orbits (level curves of H) surrounding the fixed point
exp: Near an elliptic fixed point (purely imaginary eigenvalues), H is locally a positive definite quadratic, so level sets are closed curves. The orbits are these level curves — closed trajectories (periodic orbits). Nonlinear corrections may break this picture (only Lyapunov stability, not asymptotic), but the orbits remain closed to all orders in the integrable case.
